author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0015039 NADPH-adrenodoxin reductase activity (replaced by GO:0004324 ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase activity)
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29598

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13GT3AgjgVXF6SCOgHfgGIF_qpjC9t9g1OnW_3SCs3r4/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
SGD 1 (automatic transfer)
UniProt 1 (automatic transfer)
RGD 2

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
None


Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0015039 NADPH-adrenodoxin reductase activity

author: raymond91125
body: from the ticket "Based on @hattrill 's suggestion and on the https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29598#issuecomment-2628655117 @raymond91125 cites ("both FNR types catalyze the same physiologic reaction, but they markedly differ in their structure and functional properties." >> we had decided that in these cases there would not be a distinct GO term) , so GO:0015039 'NADPH-adrenodoxin reductase activity' and GO:0004324 'ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase activity' should be merged."

author: raymond91125
source_title: Obsoletion notice: GO:0015039 NADPH-adrenodoxin reductase activity (with replacement)
